mechanism: Amphotericin B causes significant nephrotoxicity and electrolyte derangements (hypokalemia, hypomagnesemia) which can potentiate sympathomimetic effects of tranylcypromine and increase cardiovascular/hypertensive risk; tranylcypromine's MAOI activity may also impair amphotericin B metabolism.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes, and blood pressure closely; consider alternative antifungal if possible; maintain adequate hydration and supplement electrolytes aggressively.
